content.title: Bullets = Clear Lists
content.subtitle: Organize info so it's easy to read

example.text: Instead of: 'Need milk bread eggs cheese'
example.label: (One item per line)

content.audio: Bullets make clear lists. They organize information so it's easy to read. Instead of 'Need milk bread eggs cheese', write it as a list. Shopping, milk, bread, eggs, cheese. One item per line.

options.text: Cats are soft they purr they are cute

feedback.audio: That's hard to read. Try using bullets.

options.text:
Cats:
• soft
• purr
• cute

feedback.audio: Yes! Bullets make it much clearer.

options.text: soft purr cute

feedback.incorrect: What about them? Need the topic!
feedback.audio: What about them? You need the topic.

audio.question: Which is easier to read?

questions.prompt: Best format for this shopping list:

context.text: Need to buy apples bananas oranges

options.text: Need to buy apples bananas oranges

feedback.audio: Use bullets to organize the list.

options.text:
Shopping:
• apples
• bananas
• oranges
apples, bananas, oranges

feedback.audio: Bullets are clearer than commas for lists.

audio.question: Best format for this shopping list: Need to buy apples bananas oranges
